tickets.title: BUG: Projects - Proposal Status - Submit and Send to RDC save the project status so proposals reach Approval Requests
tickets.description:
From Kenneth's gap list (Freedcamp task 74048949, UPDATE as of 11-03-2026): what the original site (rdcmonitor ajax.php / plugin.php) saves that the new app does not.
- changeProposalStatus and setProposalStatus (projects.functions.ts) never write ppa_sub_items.project_status, which createProposal sets to Draft.
- Approval Requests (approval-requests.functions.ts) and the portal (portal.functions.ts) filter on it, so a proposal made and submitted in the new app never appears in Approval Requests.
- Original: submit sets 'Submit to Agency Head'; Send to RDC sets 'Sent to RDC' with rdc_sender and sent_to_rdc_timestamp; approve/return leave it.
